title: Lanterns Overhaul
description: Enhances Minecraft lanterns with detailed 3D models and smooth animated flames while keeping the vanilla style.
body:
Lanterns Overhaul improves the appearance of Minecraft lanterns with custom 3D models and animated flames.

Features:
• Custom 3D lantern models
• Animated flame effects
• Redesigned normal, soul, and copper lanterns
• Vanilla-friendly visuals
• Lightweight and performance-friendly

This pack is designed to make lanterns feel more alive and immersive without changing Minecraft's original look and feel.
